'''Zarran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] hired as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], he and two other smugglers were killed while defending [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] from an Imperial assault.
